name: filter-rail-shell
title: Filter rail shell
description: A layout for any list narrowed by filters: a rail of filter groups, a results toolbar, removable chips, an announced count and a sheet on phones.
docs: filters is a list of groups ({ id, label, activeCount, children }): the shell draws them as collapsible sections, in the rail from lg and in a sheet below it, and never renders both copies at once so no id or label exists twice. chips are the active filters ({ id, label, onRemove }); onClearAll drives Clear all in the row and Clear in the sheet; after Clear in the sheet focus moves to Show N results, so it never leaves the dialog. resultCount is shown, announced politely when it changes (from the page, or from the sheet while it is open, since a modal hides the page from screen readers) and written on the sheet's Show N results button. toolbar holds your sort and view toggle. open and onOpenChange control the sheet if you need to. Keep the filter state in the page, the shell holds none of it.
